## Assistant (Code · glm-5.3 · 23.3s)

19.1 complete — committed `e0c5e77` on `kotlin` (11 files, +726/−308). Suite: 389 tests, 0 failures; detekt + spotless clean.

**What shipped vs. what the roadmap asked:**
- **Coroutines 1.9.x/2.x migration**: already past it (was 1.10.2; no stable 2.x exists) — bumped to latest stable 1.11.0.
- **callbackFlow for AI streaming**: implemented as `Call.sseStreamFlow()` — a `channelFlow` + `awaitClose` bridge emitting `Data`/`PlainBody`/`StreamRejected`/`HttpError`. It replaces `executeStreaming`/`forEachSseData`; all three clients collect it with wire behavior byte-for-byte preserved (the existing fallback/rejection/cancel tests are the contract and stayed green). `send()` now backpressures instead of relying on the callback thread, and cancellation is pure structured concurrency — no manual `invokeOnCompletion` wiring.
- **SupervisorJob for independent parallel operations**: `executeFunctionCalls` now runs same-hop tool calls **concurrently** under `supervisorScope` with per-call failure isolation, synchronized progressive UI updates, and order-preserving aggregation (strict providers need nth-call ↔ nth-result pairing). Latency win: multi-tool turns finish at max(tool) instead of sum(tools).
- **Extra cancellation/leak fixes found along the way**: McpHttpClient's blocking `execute()` calls became cancellable `await()` (Stop now interrupts in-flight MCP calls instead of draining to timeout); `RetryManager` rethrows `CancellationException` (was retrying cancelled jobs); the notification send no longer swallows cancellation; ChatViewModel's hot stream collector is exception-safe per event.
- **StateFlow → SharedFlow**: audited, deliberately no change — every StateFlow is conflation-correct UI state (`WhileSubscribed(5000)`), and events already use `SharedFlow(DROP_OLDEST)`.

**Note on "MCP SSE"**: this app's MCP transport is request/response JSON-RPC over POST (the `Accept: text/event-stream` header is negotiation only), so there's no long-lived MCP SSE stream to bridge — the new flow foundation is the reusable piece for the future stdio/streamable-transport roadmap items.

Roadmap 19.2 committed as `b6c1547` on `kotlin` (13 files, +972/−25). Suite: 402 tests, 0 failures; detekt and spotless clean.

- **Paged windows**: chat list materializes the most recent 50 messages via index-backed `getMessagesWindow`, growing as the user reaches the top; auto-scroll now keys on last-message identity so back-filling never yanks the viewport; provider history capped at 200 messages, trimmed forward to a user turn

**Two deliberate deviations from the roadmap text** (noted in the commit):
- Paging 3 library skipped — a growing LIMIT window gives chat-style reverse infinite scroll with far less risk to the streaming/anchored-scroll UI than a `LazyPagingItems` rewrite
- `mcp_servers(endpoint)` index skipped — no query filters on `endpointUrl`; it's a tiny config table keyed by id, so the index would be pure write overhead

```kotlin
// ui/adaptive/AdaptiveLayout.kt
package com.aistudio.mcpchat.ui.adaptive

import androidx.window.layout.FoldingFeature

/** Which auxiliary pane is shown beside chat on expanded layouts. */
enum class SecondaryPane { NONE, SERVERS, INSPECTOR, SETTINGS }

data class HingeInfo(
    val isVertical: Boolean,
    val isHalfOpened: Boolean,
    val left: Int, val top: Int, val right: Int, val bottom: Int,
)

fun FoldingFeature.toHingeInfo(): HingeInfo = ...

fun twoPaneSplitFraction(parentWidthPx: Float, hinge: HingeInfo?, defaultFraction: Float = 0.5f): Float {
    if (hinge == null || !hinge.isVertical) return defaultFraction
    val centerX = (hinge.left + hinge.right) / 2f
    if (parentWidthPx <= 0f) return defaultFraction
    val fraction = centerX / parentWidthPx
    if (fraction <= 0.1f || fraction >= 0.9f) return defaultFraction
    return fraction
}

fun hingeCrossesParent(parentWidth: ...)?  // maybe not needed
```

```kotlin
@Composable
fun rememberHingeInfo(): HingeInfo? {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val activity = context as? ComponentActivity ?: return null
    val info by remember(activity) {
        WindowInfoTracker.getOrCreate(activity).windowLayoutInfo(activity)
    }.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = null)
    return remember(info) {
        info?.displayFeatures?.filterIsInstance<FoldingFeature>()?.firstOrNull()?.toHingeInfo()
    }
}
```

fun AppNavigationRail(items, currentRoute, secondaryPane, isTwoPane, onNavigate, onSelectPane) {

}

Migration effects — write carefully to avoid loops:

```kotlin
// Expanded: move any open top-level secondary route into the side pane.
LaunchedEffect(isTwoPane, currentRoute) {
    if (!isTwoPane) return@LaunchedEffect
    val pane = currentRoute?.let { paneForRoute(it) } ?: return@LaunchedEffect
    secondaryPane = pane
    navController.popBackStack(Screen.Chat.route, inclusive = false)
}

// Compact: restore the side pane as a destination so nothing is lost.
LaunchedEffect(isTwoPane, secondaryPane) {
    if (isTwoPane || secondaryPane == SecondaryPane.NONE) return@LaunchedEffect
    val route = routeFor(secondaryPane)
    secondaryPane = SecondaryPane.NONE
    navController.navigate(route) { popUpTo(findStartDestination) { saveState = true }; launchSingleTop = true; restoreState = true }
}
```
Loop risk: expand-migrate sets secondaryPane=SERVERS & pops; effect re-runs (currentRoute=chat → paneForRoute(chat)=null → return). collapse-migrate runs when isTwoPane false: navigates & clears. OK.         }
    }
}

HingeInfo:
```kotlin
/** Snapshot of a FoldingFeature's geometry, decoupled from androidx.window for testability. */
data class HingeInfo(
    val isVertical: Boolean,
    val isHalfOpened: Boolean,
    val leftPx: Int,
    val topPx: Int,
    val rightPx: Int,
    val bottomPx: Int,
) {
    val widthPx: Int get() = rightPx - leftPx
    val heightPx: Int get() = bottomPx - topPx
    val centerXpx: Float get() = (leftPx + rightPx) / 2f
    val centerYpx: Float get() = (topPx + bottomPx) / 2f
}

fun FoldingFeature.toHingeInfo(): HingeInfo = HingeInfo(
    isVertical = orientation == FoldingFeature.Orientation.VERTICAL,
    isHalfOpened = state == FoldingFeature.State.HALF_OPENED,
    leftPx = bounds.left, topPx = bounds.top, rightPx = bounds.right, bottomPx = bounds.bottom,
)

/**
 * Where to split the two panes... vertical hinge → align split with hinge
 * center; degenerate/absent hinge → default.
 */
fun twoPaneSplitFraction(parentWidthPx: Float, hinge: HingeInfo?, defaultFraction: Float = 0.5f): Float {
    if (parentWidthPx <= 0f || hinge == null || !hinge.isVertical) return defaultFraction
    val fraction = hinge.centerXpx / parentWidthPx
    if (fraction < 0.15f || fraction > 0.85f) return defaultFraction
    return fraction
}

/**
 * Vertical padding that keeps content clear of a horizontal hinge in
 * half-opened (tabletop) posture. Only engages when the hinge band sits
 * near the vertical center — otherwise content can't simply be inset.
 * Returns (topPx, bottomPx).
 */
fun horizontalHingeInsetPx(parentHeightPx: Float, hinge: HingeInfo?): Pair<Float, Float> {
    if (parentHeightPx <= 0f || hinge == null || hinge.isVertical || !hinge.isHalfOpened) return 0f to 0f
    val centerDelta = abs(hinge.centerYpx - parentHeightPx / 2f)
    if (centerDelta > parentHeightPx / 4f) return 0f to 0f
    val half = hinge.heightPx / 2f
    return half to half
}

@Composable
fun rememberHingeInfo(): HingeInfo? {
    val activity = LocalContext.current as? ComponentActivity ?: return null
    val layoutInfo by remember(activity) {
        WindowInfoTracker.getOrCreate(activity).windowLayoutInfo(activity)
    }.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = null)
    return remember(layoutInfo) {
        layoutInfo?.displayFeatures?.filterIsInstance<FoldingFeature>()?.firstOrNull()?.toHingeInfo()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
@Composable
fun MainApp() {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    var showOnboarding by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        showOnboarding = !hasSeenOnboarding(context)
    }
    val navController = rememberNavController()
    val navBackStackEntry by navController.currentBackStackEntryAsState()
    val currentRoute = navBackStackEntry?.destination?.route

    val aiProviderViewModel: AiProviderSettingsViewModel = hiltViewModel()

    val activity = context as? ComponentActivity
    @OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3WindowSizeClassApi::class)
    val widthSizeClass = activity?.let { calculateWindowSizeClass(it).widthSizeClass } ?: WindowWidthSizeClass.Compact
    val useRail = widthSizeClass != WindowWidthSizeClass.Compact
    val isTwoPane = widthSizeClass == WindowWidthSizeClass.Expanded
    val hinge = rememberHingeInfo()

    var secondaryPane by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(SecondaryPane.NONE) }

    val items = remember { listOf(Screen.Chat, Screen.Servers, Screen.Inspector, Screen.Settings) }
    val isTopLevelRoute = currentRoute == null || items.any { it.route == currentRoute }

    // Fold/unfold or resize: carry an open secondary destination into the
    // side pane instead of leaving it stacked over chat.
    LaunchedEffect(isTwoPane, currentRoute) {
        if (isTwoPane) {
            val pane = currentRoute?.let(::paneForRoute) ?: return@LaunchedEffect
            secondaryPane = pane
            navController.popBackStack(Screen.Chat.route, inclusive = false)
        }
    }
    // ...collapse effect
    LaunchedEffect(isTwoPane, secondaryPane) {
        if (!isTwoPane && secondaryPane != SecondaryPane.NONE) {
            routeForPane(secondaryPane)?.let { route ->
                navController.navigate(route) { ...saveState/restore }
            }
            secondaryPane = SecondaryPane.NONE
        }
    }
    BackHandler(enabled = isTwoPane && secondaryPane != SecondaryPane.NONE) {
        secondaryPane = SecondaryPane.NONE
    }

    val openServers: () -> Unit = {
        if (isTwoPane) secondaryPane = SecondaryPane.SERVERS
        else navController.navigate(Screen.Servers.route) { popUpTo(...findStartDestination) { saveState = true }; launchSingleTop = true; restoreState = true }
    }
    val navigateTopLevel: (Screen) -> Unit = { screen -> ...same pattern... }

    Scaffold(bottomBar = { if (!useRail) AnimatedVisibility(isTopLevelRoute) { AppBottomBar(items, currentRoute, navigateTopLevel) } }, ...) { innerPadding ->
        Row(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(innerPadding)) {
            if (useRail && (isTopLevelRoute || isTwoPane)) {
                AppNavigationRail(items, currentRoute, isTwoPane, secondaryPane, navigateTopLevel) { pane -> secondaryPane = pane }
            }
            BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                val paneAreaWidthPx = constraints.maxWidth.toFloat()
                val splitFraction = if (isTwoPane && secondaryPane != SecondaryPane.NONE) twoPaneSplitFraction(paneAreaWidthPx, hinge) else 1f
                val hingeGap = if (hinge != null && hinge.isVertical) with(LocalDensity.current) { hinge.widthPx.toDp() / 2 } else 0.dp
                val (topInsetPx, bottomInsetPx) = horizontalHingeInsetPx(constraints.maxHeight.toFloat(), hinge)
                val hingeVerticalGap = with(LocalDensity.current) { topInsetPx.toDp() } // top==bottom when engaged
                Row(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(top = hingeVerticalGap, bottom = hingeVerticalGap)) {
                    Box(Modifier.weight(splitFraction).padding(end = if (isTwoPane...) hingeGap else 0.dp)) {
                        AppNavGraph(navController, aiProviderViewModel, isTwoPane, openServers)
                    }
                    if (splitFraction < 1f) {
                        HorizontalDivider(Modifier.fillMaxHeight().width(1.dp))
                        Box(Modifier.weight(1f - splitFraction).padding(start = hingeGap)) {
                            SecondaryPaneContent(secondaryPane, onAddServer = { navController.navigate(SERVER_ADD_ROUTE) }, onEditServer = { navController.navigate(serverEditRoute(it.id)) }, onOpenServers = openServers-as-pane...)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    ... onboarding ...
}
```

anything degenerate falls back to an even split.\n */\nfun twoPaneSplitFraction(parentWidthPx: Float, hinge: HingeInfo?, defaultFraction: Float = 0.5f): Float {\n    if (parentWidthPx <= 0f || hinge == null || !hinge.isVertical) return defaultFraction\n    val fraction = hinge.centerXpx / parentWidthPx\n    if (fraction < 0.15f || fraction > 0.85f) return defaultFraction\n    return fraction\n}\n\n/**\n * Symmetric vertical inset that keeps content clear of a horizontal hinge\n * in half-openened (tabletop) posture. **Delivered:**
- **WindowSizeClass** (`material3-window-size-class` via BOM): compact phones keep the bottom bar; medium+ swap to a `NavigationRail` (testTag `navigation_rail`, same item tags as the bar)
- **Two-pane on expanded**: chat always in the primary pane with servers/inspector/settings rendered beside it (`SecondaryPane` enum + `SecondaryPaneContent`). Key design choices:
  - One NavHost at a stable composition position in every width mode — fold/resize never resets the back stack
  - Unfolding with a destination open migrates it into the pane and pops chat back; collapsing restores it as a route, so nothing is lost on device posture changes
  - System back dismisses the pane first; forms (server add/edit, provider edit) open in the chat pane while the auxiliary pane stays visible — list-detail style
- **Foldable hinges** (`androidx.window` 1.3.0): `rememberHingeInfo()` collects the FoldingFeature; a vertical fold pins the pane split to the hinge center (`twoPaneSplitFraction`, falls back to 0.5 for degenerate positions) and pads both panes off the hinge band; a centered half-opened horizontal hinge (tabletop) insets content vertically clear of the fold (`horizontalHingeInsetPx`)

All hinge math is pure Kotlin in `ui/adaptive/AdaptiveLayout.kt` with JVM tests covering split fractions, inset engagement rules, and `FoldingFeature` mapping (fake implementing the interface under Robolectric). Existing `NavigationTest` passes unchanged, confirming the compact path is untouched.

The design decision: to receive server-push notifications, I need to open a GET SSE channel per server (MCP Streamable HTTP). That's the modern spec transport. Many servers support "Streamable HTTP": GET {endpoint} Accept: text/event-stream → server may push notifications/messages. Older "HTTP+SSE" transport (2024-11-05) had a separate /sse endpoint where the server sends an "endpoint" event with the POST URL.

Implementing full streamable-HTTP GET SSE listener:
- For each subscribed server, open GET with session header, Accept: text/event-stream.
- Parse events as JSON-RPC notifications: `notifications/resources/updated` with params {uri}.
- On updated → refresh cached resource content, emit to a SharedFlow.
- Listener must handle: 405 (server doesn't offer SSE channel — Method Not Allowed per spec: client SHOULD NOT continue), disconnects → reconnect with backoff, cancellation.

114:     @Suppress("CyclomaticComplexMethod")

116:         val startTime = System.currentTimeMillis()

187:     private suspend fun ensureSession(server: McpServer): Boolean {
188:         val entry = sessions[sessionKey(server)]

190:         if (entry != null) sessions.remove(sessionKey(server))

194:     private fun isSessionError(json: JSONObject?): Boolean {
195:         if (json == null || !json.has("error")) return false

197:         val code = error.optInt("code", 0)
198:         val message = error.optString("message", "")
199:         return code == -32600 || message.contains("session", ignoreCase = true)
200:     }

202:     private suspend fun callWithSessionRetry(server: McpServer, requestJson: JSONObject, retriable: Boolean): JSONObject? =
203:         withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
204:             ensureSession(server)

206:             val send: suspend () -> Pair<Int, String> = {
207:                 try {
208:                     if (retriable) {

240:     private fun shouldSkipDueToCircuit(server: McpServer): Boolean {

262:     suspend fun discoverTools(server: McpServer): List<McpTool> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {

306:         }
307:     }

309:     private data class ToolCallResult(

311:         val isSuccess: Boolean,

315:     private fun errorResult(message: String): ToolCallResult = ToolCallResult(

321:     private fun parseToolResponse(json: JSONObject?): ToolCallResult {
322:         return when {
323:             json == null -> errorResult("Failed to connect to remote MCP server")

325:                 val message = json.getJSONObject("error").optString("message", "Unknown MCP server error")

331:                 val text = extractContentText(resultObj)

334:                 } else {
335:                     ToolCallResult(text, true, null)
336:                 }
337:             }
338:         }
339:     }
340: 
341:     private fun extractContentText(resultObj: JSONObject?): String {
342:         val contentArray = resultObj?.optJSONArray("content")
343:         if (contentArray != null && contentArray.length() > 0) {
344:             val textBuilder = StringBuilder()
345:             for (i in 0 until contentArray.length()) {
346:                 val item = contentArray.getJSONObject(i)
347:                 if (item.optString("type") == "text") {
348:                     textBuilder.append(item.optString("text"))
349:                 }
350:             }

352:         }
353:         return resultObj?.toString() ?: "{}"
354:     }

378:             if (result.isSuccess) {

384:             val latency = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime

389:                 requestPayload = requestJson.toString(2),

392:                 latencyMs = latency,

396:             Pair(result.text, logItem)

229:             emptyMap()
230:         }

233:             when (propTypes[k]) {

235:                 "number" -> v.toDoubleOrNull() ?: v
236:                 "boolean" -> v.toBooleanStrictOrNull() ?: v

}

/** True when the response body is actually delivered as an SSE stream. */
fun Response.deliversSse(): Boolean = header("Content-Type")?.trim()?.startsWith("text/event-stream", ignoreCase = true) == true

/**
 * Heuristic for endpoints that reject streaming outright: 501 Not
 * Implemented, or a 4xx whose body names streaming ("streaming is not
 * supported", "stream mode is disabled", …). Callers retry the request
 * without `stream:true` / `alt=sse` in that case.
 */
fun looksLikeStreamUnsupported(code: Int, errorBody: String): Boolean {
    if (code == 501) return true
    if (code != 400 && code != 404 && code != 405) return false
    return errorBody.contains("stream", ignoreCase = true)
}

/**
 * Terminal or in-flight outcomes of a streaming call, normalizing the
 * transport concerns (SSE framing, fallback detection) away from the
 * provider-specific payload parsing.
 */
sealed interface SseStreamEvent {
    /** One complete `data:` field payload from the SSE body. */
    data class Data(val payload: String) : SseStreamEvent

    /** 200 whose body is plain JSON — the gateway ignored the stream flag. */
    data class PlainBody(val body: String) : SseStreamEvent

    /** Endpoint rejected streaming outright — retry once without it. */
    data class StreamRejected(val code: Int, val errorBody: String) : SseStreamEvent

    /** Any other non-2xx response. */
    data class HttpError(val code: Int, val errorBody: String) : SseStreamEvent
}

/**
 * Executes the call and exposes its outcome as a cold [Flow]: SSE `data:`
 * events stream as [SseStreamEvent.Data], while non-SSE responses surface as
 * one terminal event each.
 *
 * Structured concurrency replaces the manual job-completion wiring of the
 * old `executeStreaming`: the reader coroutine runs on [Dispatchers.IO],
 * `send` backpressures when the collector falls behind, and [awaitClose]
 * cancels the underlying call the moment the collector goes away — the
 * socket close interrupts the blocking read instead of draining it to EOF
 * on a dispatcher thread.
 */
fun Call.sseStreamFlow(): Flow<SseStreamEvent> = channelFlow {
    launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
        try {
            val response = await()
            response.use {
                if (!it.isSuccessful) {
                    val errorBody = it.body?.string() ?: ""
                    val event = if (looksLikeStreamUnsupported(it.code, errorBody)) {
                        SseStreamEvent.StreamRejected(it.code, errorBody)
                    } else {
                        SseStreamEvent.HttpError(it.code, errorBody)
                    }
                    send(event)
                } else if (!it.deliversSse()) {
                    send(SseStreamEvent.PlainBody(it.body?.string() ?: ""))
                } else {
                    it.readSseData { data -> send(SseStreamEvent.Data(data)) }
                }
            }
            close()
        } catch (e: IOException) {
            close(e)
        }
    }
    // Runs on collector cancellation AND on normal completion (no-op for a
    // finished call) — either way the call never outlives the flow.
    awaitClose { this@sseStreamFlow.cancel() }
}

 * `retry:` fields and `:` comments are ignored — the AI providers encode
 * everything in `data:` payloads.
 */

    if (!forceRefresh) resourceContentCache[key]?.let { return it }
    val content = mcpHttpClient.readResource(server, uri) ?: return resourceContentCache[key]
    resourceContentCache[key] = content

suspend fun subscribeToResource(server: McpServer, uri: String): Boolean {
    val ok = mcpHttpClient.subscribeResource(server, uri)
    if (ok) {
        subscriptions... add
        ensureResourceListener(server)
    }
    return ok
}

suspend fun unsubscribeFromResource(server: McpServer, uri: String) {
    remove from subscriptions
    mcpHttpClient.unsubscribeResource(server, uri) // best-effort, ignore result
}

private fun ensureResourceListener(server: McpServer) {
    listenerJobs.computeIfAbsent(server.id) {
        resourceScope.launch {
            mcpHttpClient.resourceChannelFlow(server).collect { notification ->
                handleResourceNotification(server, notification)
            }
        }
    }
}

private suspend fun handleResourceNotification(server: McpServer, notification: McpResourceNotification) {
    when (notification) {
        is McpResourceNotification.Updated -> {
            if (notification.uri in subscriptions[server.id] ?: emptySet()) {
                val content = mcpHttpClient.readResource(server, notification.uri)
                if (content != null) resourceContentCache[resourceKey(server.id, notification.uri)] = content
                _resourceEvents.tryEmit(ResourceEvent.Updated(server.id, server.name, notification.uri, content))
            }
        }
        is McpResourceNotification.ListChanged -> {
            resourceListCache.remove(server.id)
            _resourceEvents.tryEmit(ResourceEvent.ListChanged(server.id, server.name))
        }
    }
}
